description: Na₆ZnSe₄ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃mc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZnSe₄ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent NaSe₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ZnSe₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.84-2.99 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to five Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.93-3.26 Å. Zn is bonded to four Se atoms to form ZnSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaSe₄ tetrahedra and edges with three equivalent NaSe₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.47 Å) and one longer (2.49 Å) Zn-Se bond length. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Zn atom. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven Na and one Zn atom.
